messages:
sam: Quick heads-up — benchmark blog + launch comms are set for Monday 2026-06-01 09:00 PT. Embargo lifts at 09:00 PT. Need final press list + full social kit by EOD today. @maya @diego :hourglass_flowing_sand:
maya: On it. Assembling social kit now. Do we have the final hero graphic? I thought design was finishing this morning.
diego: Design just pushed the final hero to Figma: https://figma.com/s/REDWOOD-hero. I'll also export a 1200x630 meta image variant.
sam: Thanks. PR ask — confirm priority press list pls. Current top tier: WSJ, The Verge, TechCrunch. Any last adds?
elaine: Please add VentureBeat and Platformer. I'll ping our contacts. Also suggesting a soft hold for Platformer until we confirm a short quote.
press_bot: PR outreach queued: 18 contacts. Planned outreach window = 09:00–09:30 PT. Embargo key: `redwood-bench-0601`.
maya: Social captions drafted. Question on claim language: currently says "Redwood reduces per-token cost by 2x vs baseline" — should that be softened?
sam: Use "up to 2x on selected workloads" — legal wants that hedge. @ash for signoff on final copy.
nash: OK with "up to 2x on selected workloads". Also please include a link to the methodology appendix — shortlink: https://redwood.ai/methodology
diego: Tweet thread ready. Scheduling note: set post time to UTC 16:00 so it maps to 09:00 PT consistently. Also: include a GIF demo (under 5MB) as first card for engagement.
maya: Assets checklist: hero, 3 screenshots, methodology pdf, author headshots, GIF. I'll upload everything to the shared drive by 5pm PT.
sam: Reminder: customer roster flagged as confidential — DO NOT share with press. Internal-only.
elaine: Drafting the press email now. Reply-to = press@redwood.ai. Will paste copy here in #marketing-drafts for quick review before send.
sam: Can someone own social replies for the first 4 hours post-publish? We may see spike in mentions. @diego?
diego: I can own hour 0–1, then hand off to ops. I'll create a rota doc and drop the link here.
press_bot: Reminder: embargo violation policy active — PR lead must acknowledge before distribution. React with :white_check_mark: to confirm.
sam: Acknowledged. I'll post the final press list here by 18:00 PT.
maya: Quick ask — include a short demo GIF in the tweet thread? ~4MB, loops in 6s.
diego: GIF looks good for engagement and is under 5MB — yes.
elaine: If reporters ask about dataset specifics, route them to research@redwood.ai — do not handle on-thread.
sam: Final publish checklist (compact): 1) press list 2) social assets 3) hero image 4) author bios 5) methodology link 6) embargo key 7) outreach email. Target = EOD today. :thumbsup:
maya: Upload complete — assets in Shared Drive > Marketing/BenchLaunch (12:04 PT).
press_bot: Outreach started at 2026-06-01T09:00:00Z for contacts 1-6.
sam: Closing thread — will post final status when outreach completes and monitoring is live. Thanks team!
